note: Weekly target = September monthly GA4 target × 7/30. Hong Kong booked 1,055 GA4 bookings against an 899 blended weekly target, 17.4 percent ahead, up 6.8 percent week on week and up 13.8 percent year on year. Five of six venues beat the weekly target, led by The Chinese Library (+43.3 percent) and Cantina (+24.6 percent). Dim Sum Library (−7.2 percent) is the only venue below target this week. It and Aqua HK remain the two venues behind on the FY-to-date line (−8.2 and −6.0 percent), although Aqua HK beat its weekly target by 15.8 percent. Year to date the portfolio is 6.9 percent ahead of target. Hutong HK users rose 50.8 percent week on week, mostly visitors to its National Day firework dinner page, which produced no website bookings as a landing page, so its conversion rate fell to 6.8 percent from 9.6 percent. Shiro is now shown as two sites: Shiro Pacific Place booked 66 and Shiro Tai Kwun 79. Together that is the 145 measured against Shiro's combined target of 118, 22.9 percent ahead. Tai Kwun opened in 2026, so it has no year-on-year comparison. Below the portfolio line, outside the target set: Vesu booked 105 against 100 the week before, which had only six trading days as it reopened on 8 September, and 65 in the same week last year. The Canton Library, open since 8 September, booked 31 against 13 in its opening six days. Neither is in the portfolio total or its variance.
outside_label: Outside the target set: not in the portfolio total or its variance
foot_extra: Shiro's weekly target of 118 (YTD 4,015) covers both sites, so the two Shiro rows carry no individual target and are measured together on the “Shiro, both sites” row. Shiro's Meta and Google accounts are shared by both sites, so Shiro ad spend is shown once on that row and never split. The Canton Library's cost per booking leaves out its awareness campaign spend; its Google Ads account has no booking conversion. Targets for Vesu and The Canton Library are not set yet.
